Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Striped Runner Rug, 2' 6" x 8', Beige
Colors: Beige
Materials: 80% Wool 20% Cotton
80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported Add style to your entryway or hallway with this versatile, multi-colored runner. The simple stripes and neutral hues bring interest to your home while blending in with your existing style. Simple, eye catching striped design Hand loomed. Made in India. Wears well in high traffic areas 2'6" x 8' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow up to a week for synthetic fibers to settle
